title: UN climate summit COP31 ends without a deal as EU rejects text over fossil fuels
caption:
The UN climate summit COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, ended on Sunday without a deal. The European Union, Panama and other countries rejected a final text that did not mention fossil fuels, the main cause of global warming. It is the first time since Copenhagen in 2009 that the talks have ended without an agreed outcome. Next year's summit is due to be held in Ethiopia.
